name: Raamah
overview: Raamah is identified in Scripture as a descendant of Cush, specifically named among his sons, with his own sons Sheba and Dedan continuing his lineage (Genesis 10:7; 1 Chronicles 1:9). Additionally, Raamah is associated with a region in Arabia, known for its merchants who traded valuable spices, precious stones, and gold, highlighting its significance in ancient commerce (Ezekiel 27:22). These references collectively portray Raamah both as a person within the genealogical framework of Scripture and as a place of economic importance in biblical times.
